question:

Rules: moving into a wall or the snake's own body ends the game. Eating food adds 1 to length and score.
Current state: head (13,9), moving up, length 10, food at (13,8), score 7.
Choose the next move. Prefer a SAFE move that brings the head closer to the food; avoid moves marked TRAP.

options.left: SAFE. Head moves to (12,9). Food distance 1 -> 2 (farther). Free space after move: 390 cells.
